sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Functional / Manual Tester== with 6+ years of experience validating enterprise web applications end-to-end. ==Analyses business and functional requirements, develops and executes test plans, test cases and scenarios, validates end-to-end business workflows, and tracks defects to closure== across HR, CRM, subscription and commerce platforms. ==Strong domain exposure to SaaS product testing including customer lifecycle, entitlement, billing and compliance-driven workflows==; experienced in API validation, database validation, integration testing and UAT support, collaborating with Product, Development and Business teams for high-quality releases. Automated 270+ regression test cases (BrowserStack LCNC, ACCELQ), improving regression coverage and reducing manual testing effort.

==HRMS workflows (hire-to-retire, benefits, entitlements)== · ==Payroll concepts (earnings, deductions, taxes, compliance)== · ==[HRMS / Payroll hands-on project exposure — see note]==

sections.note: FILL-IN — the JD's gate is HRMS/Payroll/PEO domain experience. Only mark this 'hands-on' if you can describe a payroll or HR lifecycle module you validated. Otherwise soften to 'domain familiarity through SaaS commerce billing/entitlement testing' and be ready to speak to payroll concepts (earnings, deductions, taxes) you can genuinely discuss.
